figures.name: Grigorios Nyssis
figures.work: Chrisi Origenikon ergaleion gia Orthodoxi Triada

concepts.core: proyparxi psychon, subordinationism, apokatastasis, eleftheria voulisis, skalosia filosofias

clues.title: Proyparxi ton psychon (noes)
clues.content: O Origen daneizetai tin platoniki/plotiniki idea oti oi psyches proyparchoun aionia se pneumatiki katastasi prin pesoun ston yliko kosmo.

clues.title: Ierarchiki alysida (ypotagi Yiou)
clues.content: Yiothetite ti neoplatoniki antilipsi oti o Yios einai ypodeesteros tou Patros (subordinationism) gia na diasfalistei i monarcheia tou Theou.

clues.title: Apokatastasi ton panton (apokatastasis)
clues.content: Chrsimopoiei to filosofiko schima proodou-epistrofis, ypostirizontas tin teliki sotiria akoma kai ton daimonon.

clues.title: Amyna kata ton Gnostikon
clues.content: Chrisimopoise ti filosofia os oplo enantion Gnostikon (Valentinos, Markion), tonizontas tin enotita Palais kai Kainis Diathikis.

clues.title: Anthropos tis Ekklisias kai Grafis
clues.content: Para ti filosofiki glossa, theoroise ton eauto tou protistos erminefti ton Grafo. Afierose ti zoi tou stin ermineia tis Vibloy (Ekapla).

clues.title: Eleftheria voulisis kata eimarmenis
clues.content: I theoria tou gia tin ptisi ton psychon den einai ylistiki, alla tonizei tin eleftheria ton logikon onto enanti tis moiras.

clues.title: Martyriko phronima kai basanistiria
clues.content: Ezise os askitis kai ypesti basanistiria gia tin pisti kata ton diogmo tou Dekiou. O skopos tou itan o Christos.

connections.description: I proyparxi (c1) einai platoniki, alla i ypotagi tou Yiou (c2) eisagei diavathmisi pou apoklinei apo ton Platona kai odigei se subordinationism.
I ypotagi tou Yiou (c2) syndeetai logika me tin apokatastasi (c3): enas mi anotatos Yios tha mporese na synchoresei ta panta.
I apokatastasi (c3) yperbainei tin amyna kata Gnostikon (c4) kai odigei se akraia oikoumenikotita pou anisychi tin Ekklisia.
I ermineia tis Grafis (c5) enischyei tin antignostiki thesi (c4): i enotita ton Diathikon einai kentriki.
I Grafi (c5) ypostirizei tin eleftheria voulisis (c6) enanti tis eimarmenis pou presvevoun oi Gnostikoi.
I eleftheria (c6) apaiti tin proyparxi (c1): oi psyches prepei na yparchoun prin tin ptosi gia na echoun eleftheria epilogis.
To martyriko phronima (c7) epivevaionei tin eilikrineia tis amynas kata Gnostikon (c4): o skopos tou itan o Christos.

rooms.name: I Stoa ton Filosofikon Ergaleion
rooms.central_question: Mporoun ta platonika ergaleia (proyparxi, ierarchia) na yperetisoun tin christianiki apokalypsi, i tin allioynanepanorthota?

rooms.name: To Dikastirio tis E' Oikoumenikis
rooms.central_question: Giati i Ekklisia katadikase ton Origen 300 chronia meta ton thanato tou? Itan oi ides tou epikindynes i oi parerminies ton 'Origeniston'?

rooms.name: I Aithousa tis Eleftherias kai tou Martyriou
rooms.central_question: Mporei i eleftheria tis voulisis kai to martyriko phronima na dikaiosoun enan theologo pou chrisimopoiise lathos ergaleia?

questions: I proyparxi ton psychon - ergaleio katanoisis i platoniki plani pou katargei tin anastasi?
An o Yios einai ypodeesteros tou Patros, pos diasfalizetai i Triada?
Mporei i skalosia tis filosofias na afairethei choris na katarreysei to dogma?
suggested_answers: I proyparxi einai ermineytiko ergaleio gia na exigisei o Origen tin proeleysi tou kakou kai tin anthropini eleftheria - den anirei tin anastasi, alla tithetai to erotima ti akrivos anistatai.
O Origen grafei prin tin Nikea; i 'ypotagi' tou Yiou antaklai mia anepexergasti triadologia, ochi airesis. Oi Kappadokes chrisimopoiisan to idio leksilogio gia na orisoun argotera tin orthodoxia.
I skalosia mporei na afairethei efoson to ktirima tou dogmatos exei oloklirothei; o Origen edose ta ylika, ochi ton teliko schediasmo.
dialogues.revelation: O Origen chrisimopoiei ti filosofia gia na apantisei se erotimata pou i apli pisti den eiche akomi diatyposei. Ta ergaleia den einai to idio to themelio.

questions: I apokatastasi ton panton - akraia elpida i logiki katalexi tis eleftherias?
Giati i E' Oikoumeniki ton katadikase, eno oi Kappadokes ton axiopoiisan?
Einai o Origen tragikos iroas i airetikos protoporos?
suggested_answers: An i eleftheria voulisis einai apolyti kai o Theos apeiros stin agapi, i apokatastasi fainetai logiki katalexi - o Origen akolouthei ti logiki os to telos tis, me kindyno na yponomefsei tin euthyni kai tin teliki krisi.
I katadikosti stoichheuse tous 'Origenistous' tou 6ou aiona pou othisan tis ides tou se akraies morfes; oi Kappadokes anelavan ta theologika epitevgnata tou eno aporripsan tis ypervolies.
O Origen einai kai ta dyo: tragikos giati i epirroi tou parerminefthike, protoporos giati charaxe to dromo gia tin christianiki theologos. I katadiki tou einai en meri adikia tis istorias.
dialogues.revelation: Choris ton Origen, oi Kappadokes den tha eichan to leksilogio gia na orisoun tin Triada. I katadiki tou afora kyrios tous akraious opadous tou, ochi ton idio.

questions: Mporei enas anthropos pou ypesti basanistiria gia ton Christo na eiche os skopo tin allioysi tis pisteos?
I eleftheria tis voulisis pou ypostirixe o Origen - itan amyntiko oplo kata tis eimarmenis i themelio mias anexartitis anthropologias?
Ti menei otan afairesoyme ti skalosia tis filosofias apo to ikodomima tou Origen?
suggested_answers: Enas anthropos pou ezise os askitis kai anechthike basanistiria den mporei na eiche os skopo tin katastrofi tis Ekklisias. O skopos tou itan i yperaspisi tou Christou me ta ergaleia pou gnorize.
I eleftheria itan kai ta dyo: amyntiko oplo kata tis gnostikis eimarmenis kai themelio mias theologias pou sevotan tin anthropini axioprepeia. Auto ton ksechorizei apo tous Gnostikous.
Menei i Grafi, i ermineia, i proseychi kai i agapi gia ton Christo. I filosofia itan to ochima, ochi o proorismos.
dialogues.revelation: I periptosi tou Origen didaskei oti o skopos (i agapi gia Christo) mporei na dikaiosei ta ergaleia, alla ta ergaleia den mporei na antikatastisoun to themelio. To provlima ton 'Origeniston' itan oti perasan ti skalosia gia themelio.
